run_remove_data_contamination: run the script to remove sentences from training data that leak into validation or test sets for multilingual datasets
run_check_train_contamination: run check_train_all to find training sentences that appear in validation or test splits across language directions
run_remove_messed_up_sentences: run remove_messed_up_sentences to filter contaminated training pairs and write cleaned source and target files to an output folder
run_get_all_test_data: run get_all_test_data to load and index all sentences from test or validation splits across multiple language directions
run_get_messed_up_test_pairs: run get_messed_up_test_pairs to find training sentence pairs that also appear in test or validation data
